name: embedded-browser-troubleshooting
title_zh: 截图空、点击失灵时先查这一张排查表
tagline_zh: 快照空、点击没反应、坐标点错窗口——别急着换独立浏览器。按这张表逐项查：先看句柄、再看焦点、最后才怀疑坐标。
tagline_en: Empty snapshots, dead clicks, wrong-window coordinates — before you jump to the standalone browser, run this.
desc_en: What to do when app_browser_* tools don't seem to work -- snapshot/find come back empty, a click/type/press_key doesn't actually register, or overlapping windows make a coordinate click risky. Use this when the embedded browser's normal tools aren't working, before considering the standalone browser.
why_zh: 把排查顺序固化成决策树，而不是让你瞎试。先验证工具链本身，再怀疑交互层。
why_en: It turns debugging into a fixed decision tree: verify the toolchain first, suspect the interaction layer second, and only blame.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 app_browser_* 系列工具（快照/查找/点击/键入/按键/坐标点击）的失效排查。不处理网络加载慢。
limit_en: Covers only app_browser_* tool failures (snapshot/find/click/type/press_key/coordinate click). Not for slow loads, JS errors, standalone-browser.
title_en: A triage card for dead embedded-browser tools
